name: abdm_hims
description: Vercel build wrapper for the abdm_hims Flutter web application.

scripts.vercel-build:
set -e

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Bootstrap the Flutter SDK (the Vercel Ubuntu build image does not ship
#    Flutter). A shallow clone of the stable channel is kept under $HOME so it
#    can be cached between builds and never requires root access.
#    NOTE: `--web-renderer` was removed in Flutter 3.44+; the default web
#    renderer is used automatically.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ! command -v flutter >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ ! -d "$HOME/flutter" ]; then
    git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"
  fi
  export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Generate web/env.js from Vercel environment variables (process.env).
#    lib/config/supabase_web_config.dart reads these values at runtime through
#    window._env_; empty values are treated as "not configured" and fall back
#    to --dart-define values / local-development constants.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p web
cat > web/env.js <<ENV_EOF
window._env_ = window._env_ || {};
window._env_.SUPABASE_URL = "${SUPABASE_URL:-}";
window._env_.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = "${SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-}";
window._env_.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY = "${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY:-}";
ENV_EOF

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Prepare the web platform and build the release bundle. The same Vercel
#    env vars are also passed as --dart-define so they are available as
#    String.fromEnvironment() values inside Dart (compile-time fallback).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
flutter config --enable-web
flutter precache --web
flutter pub get
flutter build web --release --base-href / --dart-define=SUPABASE_URL="${SUPABASE_URL:-}" --dart-define=SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-}" --dart-define=DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="${DEEPSEEK_API_KEY:-}"
